sector_survival_note: The pharmaceutical sector has seen significant consolidation and disruption over the past 30 years, but Eli Lilly has maintained its market position through strategic acquisitions and R&D investments.
thesis_summary: Eli Lilly's patented and proprietary pharmaceutical products ride the big trend of increasing demand for innovative treatments in chronic diseases.
thesis_breaks_if: If the company fails to maintain its R&D pipeline and regulatory approvals for its key products.
ten_k_highlights: Eli Lilly has a strong track record of generating free cash flow, with a cash runway of several years.
The company has a diverse portfolio of products, with a mix of established brands and newer products in development.
Eli Lilly has a significant presence in the global pharmaceutical market, with operations in over 125 countries.
valuation_note: FCF yield 0.9%, PEG 1.6, EV/EBITDA 30 — very richly valued — starter position only.
